concepts.name: DiT (Diffusion Transformer)
concepts.summary: Replace the U-Net denoiser with a plain transformer: patchify the latent to tokens, add positions, run N transformer blocks conditioned by adaLN-Zero, unpatchify back to (H,W,C) predicted noise. The transformer machinery of the Attention wing, dropped unchanged into the Diffusion framework.

concepts.name: DiT vs U-Net
concepts.summary: Two interchangeable denoisers for the SAME diffusion framework (forward, reverse, CFG, latent all unchanged). U-Net: conv + low-res attention + skips + up/down sampling. DiT: patchify + plain transformer blocks + unpatchify, positions instead of conv, adaLN-Zero conditioning. DiT scales more predictably (LLM scaling laws) so large models (Sora, SD3, PixArt) migrate to it.
